name: BACH_0109
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set is InSitu only, input is reliable, second model agrees [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 100%, Invasive 0% | One class dominates |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class, unambiguous |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 94th percentile | Not flagged; fairly atypical |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 InSitu | Mostly agree [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 5, 7, 9) · ↓ invasive · Associated with lower invasive likelihood · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 6, 11) · ↑ invasive · Concept model links it to invasive carcinoma · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 1, 5, 11) · context · Higher than 97% of reference images [F7] · Measured
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 2, 6) · ↑ invasive · High score; failed spot check (0/20) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007): not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses and necrosis are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Nearest Invasive neighbor (BACH_0265) differs mainly in necrosis and duct-confined scores, both poorly validated.
- Conformal coverage (92%) is dataset-level on a small test set, not per-case.

## Check on the slide
1. **5, 7, 9**: confirm atypical cells stay within ducts, no stromal invasion.
2. **8**: highest per-region invasive probability (12%); look for infiltrating stroma.
3. **6, 10, 11**: heatmap's most invasive-leaning regions; verify pleomorphism and necrosis.
